summary: Firefox expands CSS support with `grid-lanes`, a layout mode for arranging content in lanes, and improves scroll-driven animations, which respond to a page’s scrolling. It also rounds out CSS Typed OM (the web API for working with CSS values in JavaScript), including numeric comparisons and transform features, while fixing cases such as CSS zoom affecting translations. Many other changes refine CSS value handling and built-in styles, alongside behind-the-scenes cleanup.
